notes.title: Add post-clearing features and achievements
notes.notes:
[b]Added timer to stage select after clearing[/b].
You will be able to check your best time for each stage.

[b]Added boss rush mode to stage select after clearing[/b].
[b]You will be able to challenge the all boss rush with no deaths.

[b]We've added achievements related to the above two new features[/b].
You can also check the conditions from the achievements, so please challenge them!

notes.title: Addition of clear achievements
notes.notes:
[b]Adding Achievements[/b]
We've added a new achievement for clearing all stages.
Even if you have already cleared a stage, it will be unlocked on the stage select screen.

[b]Future Plans[/b]
I'm planning to add boss rush mode, time attack in stage select mode, and achievements related to these modes.
I'm currently working on this.

notes.title: Data Reset
notes.notes:
Addition of data reset function.
Hold R key in Title.
